ICS 206 WF rebuilt as a real per-incident editable form (commit 930e82a, merged to main). Audited the shipped schema against the actual NWCG form + completion instructions: old shape was modeled on the research doc summary table and was missing ALL phone numbers (blocks 3/4/5 each require one), hospital VHF, and both Area Location Capability (block 6) + Remote Camp Locations (block 7); it also carried a medical-aid-stations block that does not exist on the WF variant. Now all 7 blocks + signature block as an autosaving accordion, all-string values (paper form is free text), tri-state Yes/No so an unchecked box is not silently No. Data is incident-scoped: one doc per incident keyed by local incident number (Black Canyon 08/13/2026 -> 26BC0813001), index + active-incident pointer, same storage keys on web and mobile. Burn calculator now reads burn centers from the active incident instead of a bundled constant. Also pulled + pinned ICS 220 WF (03/25, block 12 Extraction/Medevac) and ICS 204 WF (08/25, CUI//Basic) for the next build. Owner feedback round 2 (commit 4a730b8, EAS group e4aa54b1, channel verified serving it). (1) PATIENT COUNT + TABS: section 2 gets a patient-count stepper (the form own section 2 example says including number of patients so this is faithful); section 3 becomes PT 1/PT 2/PT 3 tabs colour-coded by per-patient severity, adjustable any direction. Per-patient severity is an ADDITION to the paper form - printed 206 WF has one incident-level severity in section 2 then says start with the most severe patient without giving a per-patient cell; section 2 priority left untouched. Unset severity renders neutral not green (not-assessed != minor). Stepper REFUSES to drop a patient with anything recorded and reports how many it kept. (2) AUDIO PAUSE added w/ running position + restart; replaying a finished note seeks to 0 first. (3) SECTION 6 COMMS FILL is now OPT-IN - previous build silently seeded COMMAND from the loaded plan, which was wrong (a frequency the medic did not enter is one they read out unchecked, and section 1 of the form says verify correct frequency prior to starting report); now a button, names its source, warns to verify before transmitting, and only carries the medical emergency channel because that is the only comms value the 206 WF holds (rest is ICS 205, not ingested). (4) RECORDING added to contingency + additional information. BLACK triage category added (commit 4ea15e7, EAS group 251646d6, channel verified serving Android 019ffc29). Placed on PER-PATIENT severity in section 3, deliberately NOT on section 2 Severity of Emergency / Transport Priority - that block is a transport priority and the printed 206 WF lists exactly three, and a patient dead without possibility of resuscitation is not a transport priority; section 3 per-patient triage is already an app addition so the 4th category belongs there. Test pins both halves (SEVERITIES=4, PRIORITY_TEXT=3). Two black-specific treatments: true black is invisible on a near-black ground so tab+picker draw it filled with a light outline (a treatment nothing else uses) and DIM rather than hollow when unselected, since a black tag must never read as not-yet-assessed; and it is spoken as BLACK / DECEASED over the radio not the bare colour word - that changed the script format for all severities, which the existing test caught. Panel header now spells out the active patient severity so triage is legible as text not colour alone.
